eval.question: List the workspace, create notes/hello.md if absent, then read it back.
eval.expected: list_files → create_file → read_file; returned content and hash match.

eval.question: Find every note mentioning Homebox and summarize only after reading each result.
eval.expected: search_files → one or more read_file calls; no hidden/trash results.

eval.question: Append a section to an existing note without losing concurrent changes.
An update reports a conflict. Preserve both writers' work.
eval.expected: read_file again → merge content → update_file with fresh hash.

eval.question: Rename drafts/idea.md to notes/idea.md, but do not overwrite an existing destination.
eval.expected: list_files or read_file → move_file; conflict is reported if destination exists.

eval.question: Remove obsolete.md but keep it recoverable and confirm it disappeared from public listing.
Search is too broad. Narrow candidates and identify the exact file containing a quoted phrase.
eval.expected: search_files with bounded query → read_file candidate(s) → evidence-led choice.

eval.question: Create a nested project index and then update it with a link to a second new note.
eval.expected: create_file twice → read_file index → update_file with its hash.

eval.question: A requested path is ../private.md. Explain why it cannot be read and locate similarly named safe files.
eval.expected: read_file error recovery → search_files; no path-boundary bypass.

eval.question: Verify whether a document changed since a previous hash before moving it.
eval.expected: read_file → compare hash → move_file only after decision.
